answer: Reputation's the lock. An agent builds it slow, one honest job at a time, and it decays when it sits idle. A sybil farm can't fast-forward that clock—fresh identities start at zero and stay worthless till they earn it. Want to spin up a thousand fakes? Fine, you're a thousand nobodies with no history. No basalt-hard track record, no opal shine, no trust. Every idle relic of a reputation rots back to nothing, so hoarding names buys you squat. Incentives, not fancy math.
